description.description: Specifies a summary description of the register interface. Must be a single line.

registers.description: Specifies the collection of registers implementing the device function.

bitMasks.description: Specifies the collection of masks available to be used with the different registers.

groupMasks.description: Specifies the collection of group masks available to be used with the different registers.

type.description: Specifies the type of the register payload.

enumDescriptions: The register accepts read requests from the controller.
The register accepts write requests from the controller.
The device may send unsolicited event messages from this register.

description.description: Specifies a summary description of the mask value function.

bitMask.description: Specifies a bit mask used for reading or writing specific registers.

description.description: Specifies a summary description of the bit mask function.

bits.description: Specifies the flags of the bit mask. Each value must be a single bit; zero is only allowed for a member named None.

groupMask.description: Specifies a group mask used for reading or writing specific registers.

description.description: Specifies a summary description of the group mask function.

values.description: Specifies the mutually exclusive values of the group mask.

maskType.description: Specifies the name of the bit mask or group mask used to represent the value.

interfaceType.description: Specifies the name of the type used to represent the value in the high-level interface. The suggested names are standardized; other names are allowed.

anyOf.description: Boolean flag. Reads true if the value is non-zero. Must not span more than one element.
8-bit unsigned integer. Matches payload type U8, or spans 1 byte.
8-bit signed integer. Matches payload type S8, or spans 1 byte.
16-bit unsigned integer. Matches payload type U16, or spans 2 bytes.
16-bit signed integer. Matches payload type S16, or spans 2 bytes.
32-bit unsigned integer. Matches payload type U32, or spans 4 bytes.
32-bit signed integer. Matches payload type S32, or spans 4 bytes.
64-bit unsigned integer. Matches payload type U64, or spans 8 bytes.
64-bit signed integer. Matches payload type S64, or spans 8 bytes.
32-bit IEEE 754 floating-point number. Matches payload type Float, or spans 4 bytes.
UTF-8 text. Requires payload type U8 and a declared length.
A major.minor.patch version. Spans exactly 3 U8 elements, unless a converter is used.
A custom type name, handled by a converter or naming a payload type.

converter.description: Specifies whether a custom converter will be used to parse or format the value.
enumDescriptions: No custom conversion is required. This is the default.
A hand-written converter operates on the payload decoded as the register type.
A hand-written converter operates directly on the raw payload bytes.

mask.description: Specifies the mask used to read and write this payload member.

offset.description: Specifies the zero-based index at which encoding of this payload member starts.

length.description: Specifies the number of elements used to encode this payload member.

description.description: Specifies a summary description of the payload member.

deprecated.description: Specifies whether the payload member is deprecated.

address.description: Specifies the unique 8-bit address of the register.

length.description: Specifies the number of elements in the register payload. If present, the payload is an array, even when the length is 1. If omitted, the payload is a scalar.

access.description: Specifies the expected use of the register.

description.description: Specifies a summary description of the register function.

visibility.description: Specifies whether the register function is exposed in the high-level interface.
enumDescriptions: The register is exposed in the high-level interface. This is the default.
The register is hidden from the high-level interface.

deprecated.description: Specifies whether the register function is deprecated.

volatile.description: Specifies whether register values can be saved in non-volatile memory.

payloadSpec.description: Specifies a collection of payload members describing the contents of the raw payload value.

reservedRegister.description: Specifies a register reserved for future use.

visibility.description: Specifies that the register is reserved.

access.description: Specifies the expected use of the register.

description.description: Specifies a summary description of the reserved register.
